item.title: One-minute frequency disturbances from unintended synchronization in cyber–physical power systems
item.description:

Nature Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in identifying clock-synchronized control software in digital energy devices (UPSs, battery storage) as the previously unexplained source of persistent 1-min grid-frequency oscillations, revealing a subtle cyber–physical coupling. Its significance: these oscillations are growing, causing hydropower wear and tighter frequency-control rules, and may amplify with expanding batteries, data centres and IoT—highlighting the need for better control design.
🏷 grid frequency · battery storage · cyber-physical systems · UPS · power oscillations

item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a shared-Zn energy routing architecture: a Zn mesh couples a W/WO3 display electrode with a MnO2 storage electrode, enabling self-driven coloration and internally powered bleaching. An optical cavity decouples color from storage chemistry. Significance: this compact design integrates display refreshing, optical memory, and energy output, advancing self-powered wearable displays with sensing capability.

item.title: Toward Practical Zn‐Ion Batteries Through Separator/Electrolyte Co‐Design
item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in co-designing a hybrid organic-aqueous electrolyte with thin polypropylene separators, overcoming the hydrophobicity that makes Li-ion separators incompatible with aqueous Zn-ion batteries. This enables uniform Zn plating, suppresses hydrogen evolution, and extends cycling to 4360 h. Replacing thick glass fiber separators boosts pouch cell energy density over 2.5-fold, offering a practical route to high-performance Zn-ion batteries.

item.title: Fundamental Inhibition of Polyiodide Formation by a Site‐Separated Binder for Highly Stable Aqueous Zinc–Iodine Batteries
item.description:
یک بایندر پلیمری با جداسازی جایگاه‌های فعال، تشکیل پلی‌یدید را در باتری آبی Zn-I2 مهار کرده و ظرفیت و پایداری چرخه‌ای را به‌شدت بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a site-separated polymer binder that selectively confines I₂ and I⁻ at distinct side-chain groups, chemically blocking polyiodide formation at its source. This enables direct I₂/I⁻ conversion, superior rate performance (102 mAh g⁻¹ at 50 A g⁻¹), and 97.1% retention over 31,000 cycles—significantly advancing stable aqueous Zn–I₂ battery cathodes.
